content: {"episode_id":"ep-05161","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient presenting with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1). Given the history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9), prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with these neurological symptoms and dizziness (R42). The documented indication supports the medical necessity of prolonged ambulatory monitoring rather than a shorter study, and we request reconsideration of the CO-22 denial."}
